title: Quinoa, Spinach and Cheese Patties with Garam Masala
subtitle: with cucumber raita
description: Quinoa and spinach patties with feta-style cheese and garam masala, fried until golden and served with a cooling cucumber raita. The mixture needs 2 hours in the fridge to firm up before frying.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa. Place it in a pot with 360 ml water, 1 tablespoon oil and half a teaspoon of salt and bring to the boil. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and wait about 10 minutes until the quinoa is cooked and white rings appear around the grains. Fluff with a fork and cool.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large frying pan and wilt the spinach. Add 1 clove of crushed garlic and stir for a few seconds until fragrant.
Season with salt, transfer to a chopping board, chop roughly and place in a bowl.
Add 1.5 cups cooked quinoa, the ginger, chilli, garam masala, eggs, diced cheese and half the chopped coriander and mix. Refrigerate for 2 hours to firm up.
Shape into flat patties about 4 cm across and fry for 2 minutes on each side until golden. Drain on paper towel.
For the raita, mix the yoghurt, grated cucumbers, a pinch of cumin, 1 to 2 crushed garlic cloves, the remaining chopped coriander, the mint and salt. Serve alongside the patties.
